title: Self-Describing Peripherals: A Lightweight Schema for Modular Embedded Systems
abstract: We present a 256-byte descriptor format for embedded peripherals that allows a host MCU to enumerate, configure, and validate attached modules without recompilation. We evaluate the approach on a 4-axis motion controller and demonstrate that self-description reduces integration time by 80% versus static configuration.

title: Decoupling Marks from Content in Collaborative Rich-Text
venue: Workshop on Programming Models for Distributed Systems
abstract: Existing CRDT designs for rich-text store formatting marks inline with content, leading to ambiguous convergence under concurrent style edits. We propose modeling marks as a separate metadata CRDT, indexed by stable content anchors, and show that this eliminates a class of merge anomalies present in mainstream implementations.

title: Low-Cost Spectroscopy for Undergraduate Education: Design and Field Results
abstract: We describe the design and classroom evaluation of an open-source UV-Vis spectrometer costing under $200 per unit. Across three semesters and 142 students, instrument-derived absorbance values agreed with commercial reference instruments to within 3.1% RMSE across the 400–700 nm range.
